title: Simulation-trained inference maps accreted stellar mass in nearby galaxies
summary: A model trained on simulated galaxy observations inferred accreted stellar fractions in nearby MaNGA galaxies. Predictions suggest in-situ formation dominates most of the studied mass range, while accreted fractions rise in the most massive systems and vary with galaxy characteristics. These are simulation-dependent inferences, not direct measurements of each star's formation history. The result preceded the July 2024 journal article.
organization: Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias; University of La Laguna; Max Planck Institute for Astronomy

evidence.tested: Model inference was evaluated with simulated observations and applied to real survey data.
evidence.unknown: Observational ground truth and transfer beyond the training simulation remain unresolved.
evidence.ai_role: MaNGIA/TNG50-trained stellar-mass inference supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary v1 abstract, history, affiliations and selected HTML Methods; supplements not reviewed.
